title: Grace and the Adventure of Leadership
description: In this sermon, the speaker discusses the topic of grace and the adventure of leadership. He admits that he did not initially volunteer to preach this message, but he believes it is a reflection of his life's work. The speaker emphasizes the importance of expressing gratitude to God and highlights a verse from the Bible that expresses deep thanksgiving. He also shares his disbelief that he gets paid to do what he loves and compares it to the idea of sports writers learning to write by the second grade.
